text:
For a conversion in the **Caribbean and Latin America (CALA)**, the usual soft-brand/collection long list includes:

| Hotel company | Brands commonly considered | Typical fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **The Luxury Collection**, **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio** | Luxury through upper-upscale independent hotels and resorts. Autograph is especially relevant to distinctive full-service and all-inclusive resorts; Tribute generally offers a somewhat more approachable upscale/upper-upscale positioning. Marriott explicitly positions all three as collection brands for independent hotels. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **LXR Hotels & Resorts**, **Curio Collection by Hilton**, **Tapestry Collection by Hilton** | LXR for selective luxury; Curio for upper-upscale/luxury boutiques and resorts; Tapestry for upscale, often smaller or less amenity-intensive properties. Curio and Tapestry are strongly conversion-oriented and already expanding across CALA. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/lxr-hotels-resorts-to-launch-in-the-americas-with-zemi-beach-house-hotel-spa-in-anguilla?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **Destination by Hyatt**, **JdV by Hyatt** | Unbound for story-rich luxury; Destination for experiential resorts and residences; JdV for upscale lifestyle and neighborhood-oriented hotels. Hyatt has recently expanded these options in Belize, Punta Cana and the Dominican Republic. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/news-releases?item=124064&utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Vignette Collection**; also **voco** where a conversion brand rather than a pure collection is acceptable | Vignette for independent luxury and lifestyle hotels; voco for premium conversions that can accept a somewhat clearer brand overlay. Vignette entered South America through Lima, while voco has conversion activity in Mexico and planned Caribbean expansion. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/vignette-collection?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **Emblems Collection**, **MGallery Collection**, **Handwritten Collection** | Emblems for luxury, MGallery for upper-upscale/luxury boutiques and resorts, and Handwritten for midscale/upscale independent hotels. Accor emphasizes conversions, flexible standards and preservation of the hotel’s existing identity. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/franchising-accor-luxury-lifestyle-strategy?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham** | **Registry Collection Hotels**, **Trademark Collection by Wyndham**; sometimes **Dolce Hotels & Resorts** | Registry for luxury resorts, Trademark for upper-midscale through upper-upscale independents, and Dolce for destination resorts or meetings-oriented properties. Wyndham identifies these as flexible soft-brand conversion options. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/convert-your-existing-hotel?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Meliá Hotels International** | **The Meliá Collection**, **Affiliated by Meliá** | Particularly relevant for Spanish-speaking markets and beach resorts. The Meliá Collection targets independent luxury hotels; Affiliated by Meliá is a lighter commercial and distribution alliance for mid-market and upscale properties. ([onboarding.melia.com](https://onboarding.melia.com/landings/home_english.html?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice Hotels** | **Ascend Hotel Collection**, **Radisson Individuals** | Ascend for upscale boutique, historic and resort conversions; Radisson Individuals for larger full-service upper-upscale hotels. Generally considered where owner autonomy and lower brand-imposed design constraints are priorities. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/sfsites/c/cms/delivery/media/MCUMJCKAM4XNGDBGYQ36NVQN55WE?utm_source=openai)) |
| **BWH Hotels/WorldHotels** | **WorldHotels Luxury, Elite, Crafted and Distinctive**; **BW Premier Collection**, **BW Signature Collection** | Useful for owners seeking collection affiliation with relatively high operating independence. WorldHotels has active properties in Mexico, Honduras, Bonaire and other regional leisure markets. ([worldhotels.com](https://www.worldhotels.com/content/luxury-hotels/en_US/press-media/2026/wh-portfolio-growth.html?utm_source=openai)) |

### Practical shortlisting

For most CALA conversion studies, I would initially benchmark:

- **Luxury resort:** Luxury Collection, LXR, Unbound, Vignette, Emblems/MGallery, Registry or The Meliá Collection.
- **Upper-upscale boutique or resort:** Autograph, Curio, Tribute, Destination, MGallery or WorldHotels Elite/Crafted.
- **Upscale urban or smaller resort:** Tapestry, JdV, Handwritten, Trademark, Ascend or Affiliated by Meliá.
- **Maximum independence:** Preferred Hotels & Resorts, Leading Hotels of the World, Design Hotels or WorldHotels may also be evaluated. These are closer to membership, marketing and distribution affiliations than conventional hotel franchises, although the commercial support and loyalty integration differ substantially. ([lhw.com](https://www.lhw.com/corporate/about-us?utm_source=openai))

**One emerging option:** IHG launched **Noted Collection** in February 2026 for upscale-to-upper-upscale conversions. It is worth monitoring, but its initial rollout is centered outside CALA and it has a very limited operating track record so far. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2026/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-unveils-new-premium-collection-brand-noted-collection?utm_source=openai))

The final choice normally turns less on the nominal “softness” of the brand and more on the required PIP, key money, franchise versus management availability, territorial protection, all-inclusive capability, owner naming rights, loyalty contribution and total system cost. Luxury collection brands can preserve identity while still imposing substantial life-safety, technology, service, F&B and design requirements.
